Calculate PSR/DSR on valid net strategy returns, accounting for the search history and uncertainty in effective independent trials. “Deflated Sharpe remains positive” in [capital_gate.py](../../reports/api/routes/capital_gate.py) is not a meaningful pass rule: the usual DSR is a probability, so merely being above zero is almost vacuous. Define a justified probability threshold, minimum sample and economic effect, not a badge. [Bailey and López de Prado's original DSR paper](https://www.davidhbailey.com/dhbpapers/deflated-sharpe.pdf).

Aggregate winning scores are insufficient for calibration, reproducibility, error attribution or counting trials. Save fold IDs, training bounds, all candidate scores, selected params, scaler state, predictions/probabilities, label definition, seed, elapsed time and source/data hashes. Define whether fold scores are equally weighted or observation-weighted. Validate at public boundaries with explicit errors rather than relying on removable `assert` statements.
